hands.name: Ada Mercer
hands.pitch: I don't need much. I need to not be on the road after dark.
hands.secret: Walked out of a Hull work gang owing money.

hands.name: Tomas Reyes
hands.pitch: I've buried two farms. I'd like to see one live.
hands.secret: His last farm went to raiders because he opened the gate.

hands.name: June Oyelaran
hands.pitch: Feed me and I'll work. Don't feed me and I'll still work, but slower.
hands.secret: Has a brother in a Listener camp.

hands.name: Wes Harlan
hands.pitch: Used to drive for the Hull. Can't stomach the road any more.
hands.secret: Lost a convoy, and the people on it.

hands.name: Priya Lakhani
hands.pitch: I know soil. Whatever's wrong with yours, I've seen worse.
hands.secret: Trained at a Meridian site before the war.
